kind: reviewer independent hand derivation, separately checked by execution-v1.json

recurrence.full_length: (N-1)*2+(4-1)+1=2N+2 for dilation=1,padding=output_padding=0. Lesson keeps indices 0..2N-1 and discards last two samples at end.
recurrence.causal_proof: At output samples 2i and 2i+1 only x_i and x_(i-1) appear. No x_j for j>i can contribute before index 2j; therefore any change in codes j>=2 cannot affect output indices 0..3. Partition boundaries only determine how many recurrence steps are called together.

normalization: If an early sample is replaced by (y_t - mean(y_all)), changing only the future can change mean(y_all), hence early normalized samples. The same objection applies to a standard deviation computed using all times. This is a dependence claim, not a claim that all normalization is noncausal.

measurement_contract.TTFA: t_first_valid_waveform_arrives_client - t_server_received_complete_valid_request; includes preprocessing, generation, decoding and transmission inside these endpoints. It does not include time before the chosen origin.
measurement_contract.duration: chunk_duration_seconds = number_of_samples / sample_rate_in_samples_per_second. No sample rate is assigned to the 8-sample toy waveform.
measurement_contract.RTF: course_RTF = compute_seconds / produced_audio_seconds; RTF<1 means average computation in the stated steady interval is faster than its audio duration, not an initial-wait measure or a guarantee about jitter/network/playout. EnCodec_v1_RTF=1/course_RTF for identical timing scope.
measurement_contract.scope: No real request, player, clock measurement, training, weight loading or inference is involved in these equations.

comparison_boundary: Qwen2.5 DiT 2 lookback+current+1 lookahead is not replaced by the toy 0-lookahead guarantee; Qwen3 left-context codec still needs current Talker+MTP frame tokens and compute. EnCodec initial algorithmic latency is distinct from computation and convention-dependent RTF.
